h: Before you start, and after you finish
p: A few tips to give your team the edge. Wear trainers and something comfortable, because you'll be on your feet and moving quickly. Leave coats and bags out of the way, listen to the briefing, and agree roles early on, with someone on targets, someone on puzzles and someone keeping an eye on the clock. Families with younger kids should go for a gentler game; teens and adults can pick something more frantic.

Right next to Xscape, the Junction 32 Outlet Shopping Village is handy if anyone in your group wants a browse for a bargain while the others play. Castleford itself has a proud rugby league tradition, with the Castleford Tigers based in the town, and the sculptor Henry Moore was born here, which is a nice bit of trivia for anyone who knows his famous works.

Nearby Pontefract has the ruins of its castle, which played a big part in the English Civil War, and the town is famous for liquorice, with Pontefract cakes still made in the area. For nature lovers, RSPB Fairburn Ings is a short drive away and is a great place to spot birds on the wetlands.
Put it all together and you can easily make a full day of it: a gaming session, a slide down the snow, a shop or two and a walk in the fresh air.
